summary: Iteration 2 E2E testing of LifeOS Step C fixes (Hevy-style program/exercise dialogs + auto-estimated body metrics). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passing including new tests for enriched GET /api/programs/{id}, GET /api/exercises/{id}, enriched /api/routines, /body-metrics/latest with all 7 metrics+source field, manual-override source flag, and partial PUT /api/auth/profile merge. Frontend: login → workout/Explore renders 14 program cards → ProgramDetailDialog opens with badges, Save Program button, routines list, 12 exercise items → ExerciseDetailDialog opens showing start/end images from raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas + 'How to do it' instructions → Save Program button text correctly flips to 'Saved to My Routines' and 3 routines (Full Body 3x — Full Body A/B/C) appear in My Routines tab. BodyMetrics page now shows all 7 cards with computed numeric values (16.4 Logged, 40.6 Estimated muscle, 2.63 Estimated bone, 59.5 Estimated hydration, 30 Estimated metabolic age, 23.7 Auto BMI, 1728 Auto BMR) — no '—' placeholders. Theme toggle, ExercisePicker (66 items), and all 5 placeholder routes still render. Partial profile merge regression confirmed fixed.

issues: Recharts still emits 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warning when a metric has <2 data points — carry-over from iteration 1, no visual impact
Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — accessibility nit; add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to ProgramDetailDialog/ExerciseDetailDialog to silence Radix a11y warning
Optional: set minWidth/minHeight on Recharts ResponsiveContainer in BodyMetrics to silence width(-1) warning

Consider: data-testid on individual metric cards (current testids use 'metric-card' prefix in source but rendered DOM did not match my selector probe — verify naming convention if you want automated coverage of badges)
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/auth/profile now correctly merges (line 250-256) — iteration 1 RCA fixed and verified by new partial-merge test.
_enrich_program_with_images (server.py:290) batches a single $in query — efficient. Same pattern reused in list_routines.
Body metric estimator formulas are well-isolated pure functions (_compute_body_fat / _compute_muscle_mass_pct / _compute_bone_mass / _compute_hydration / _compute_metabolic_age) — easy to unit test.
seed_exercises now updates image_url + instructions on every startup (server.py:589) — fixes drift between seed_data.py and DB.
Login endpoint still lacks brute-force lockout — unchanged from iteration 1, recommend adding rate limit.
Save Program client-side likely POSTs each routine individually; consider batching into a single /api/programs/{id}/import endpoint to reduce N requests and partial-failure surface.
Frontend: 3 'Full Body 3x —' routines persist in admin account post-test (intentional, to prove Save Program worked end-to-end). Next agent may want to DELETE before retesting Save Program flow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_lifeos_backend.py (added 6 new test cases: get_program_enriched, get_program_404, get_exercise_by_id, get_exercise_404, list_routines enrichment assertion, all_seven_metrics_with_source, manual_log_overrides_estimate_source, partial_profile_update_preserves_fields)

rca_of_issues_addressed: Iteration 1 reported: (a) PUT /api/auth/profile wiped non-supplied fields; iteration 2 server.py:250-256 now does merge — verified by test_partial_profile_update_preserves_fields (sends only weight_kg, asserts age/height/sex preserved, BMI recomputes to 25.2). (b) /body-metrics/latest only returned BMI+BMR; iteration 2 now returns all 7 metrics with 'source' field — verified by test_all_seven_metrics_with_source (body_fat≈18, muscle≈40.6, bone=2.63, hydration=59.5, metabolic_age=30 all match expected).
